svg.aria-label: How Lightwarden fits into a frame: the game draws the world, the add-on replaces lighting and adds atmosphere and water, ReShade effects add the camera and tonemap, the game draws its UI on top, and the Dalamud plugin feeds them all.
svg.text: Shadows, AO, bounce light and lamps,
swapped in for the game's own.
on the scene's real light values.
Bloom, lens flare, depth of field and
motion blur, on the light itself.
Drawn last, on top of everything.
THE EYES ON THE GAME, AND YOUR SETTINGS
Every frame it reads the camera, weather, time of day, zone, lights and characters from the game,
and passes them to the add-on and the effects along with your settings and preset.
REAL BUFFERS FROM A LIGHTWARDEN CAPTURE. SIMPLIFIED: THE REAL FRAME HAS MANY MORE PASSES
